title: Shared GRUDGE6 ↔ Spawn prefab manifest (unit, vendor, NPC)
description: One catalog both the info.grudge-studio.com GRUDGE6 Characters lab and the Spawn world @racalvin/grudge-warlords read. A prefab is a role + faction + race kit + mesh_ids + optional weapon, used to build a unit, a vendor, or an NPC faction character. Draft only — not published, not minted. v0.2 adds Worge and Verduror shapeshift forms (union of the Grimoire of Forms, Nature Grimoire, foundry claw list, and Grudge-Builder legendary forms), race/faction variants, a live-iguana example prefab, a Kiln bakeQueue (one pre-baked GLB per humanoid prefab, with clips), and the 80 canonical alias meshIds as meshOptions. Draft only. v0.2.1: live form play models use documented cdn/value.<sha>.glb names from world.assets.yaml (no https://www.spawn.co/cdn/… and no ?animations= on cdn/ uploads; withAnimations only for /magic/ URLs). Pending-bake prefabs omit the model key entirely (not model: null) and must have no scene rows until Kiln bakes and bakedStatus==='live'.

owners.assetBinaries: Kiln (generate, bake, ingest to R2) — female mesh_id enumeration, mount/siege bake, lab-weapon ITEM stamps as needed

owners.review: Verdict — signs the Spawn world patch and the ObjectStore info-page change before any push or deploy

identity.meshOptionKey: meshId — the Toon RTS GLB Object3D name (e.g. WK_Units_Body_C, BRB_weapon_sword_B). This is the picker option. It is not an RFC UUID and not a bag instance.
identity.weaponOptionKey: weaponId — lab_weapon:{id} for external tier GLBs, or kit:{raceId}:{meshId} for weapons already inside the race kit. ITEM-* only after Muster stamps master-weapon-prefabs. Never mint ITEM-* in this file.
identity.prefabKey: prefabId — Muster mints PFAB-ENT-* per uuid-law. Drafts use the DRAFT-PFAB-G6-* prefix and must not be treated as minted, placed as bag SSOT, or used as a player character PK.
identity.playerIdentity: GrudgeID / characters.id (RFC UUID) on the server. Never in world code.
identity.payouts: GBuX and vendor settlement stay on grudge-api. This manifest is appearance + role only. No keys or secrets in the Spawn world.

gaps.dwarfUnityCatalog: unityArmourByRace.dwarf has 0 mesh ids; dwarf golden kit + classLoadouts + Spawn stems are populated. Trust the kit, not the Unity review table.
gaps.undeadUnityWeapons: unityArmourByRace.undead.weaponMeshIds is nearly empty (misclassified UD_body_spearman). Use named-sockets / loadouts.
gaps.entityPrefabMeshes: 36 existing PFAB-ENT unit rows: warrior/archer often have baked whole-body GLBs; mage/merc/paladin/heavy_merc often point at *Characters.fbx (banned for play). This bridge does not reuse those URLs as the play body.
gaps.factionUnitsJson: factionUnits.json is 19 2D sprite RTS units, not Toon 3D kits. Do not treat it as this manifest.
gaps.npcRoster: npc-roster.json is role slots (vendor, innkeep, sergeant…) per faction with no meshes. This manifest supplies the missing 3D appearance.
gaps.vendorPrefabs: warlords-entity-prefabs has no vendor or NPC kinds. Spawn vendors today are dialogue + ITEM-* stock, models from mixed /cdn/ or outfit sets.
